newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN GAS SHARES AVERAGE 8,506 VOUCHER KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN GAS SHARES AVERAGE 8,506 VOUCHER KROONS.

text.p: The Estonian Privatisation Agency said on Wednesday that the average price for the public offer of Estonian Gas shares was 8,506 voucher kroons.
The average price of Hotel Olumpia shares was 525 voucher kroons and that of metal trading company Esmeta 1.82 voucher kroons, the agency's director Vaino Sarnet told a news conference.
Privatisation vouchers, the securities distributed by government to compensate the population for assets seized under the Soviets, closed at 0.329 kroons on Tuesday on the Tallinn bourse.
The price tag for 12.33 percent of the shares in Estonian Gas (Eesti Gaas) was 406.9 million voucher kroons.
The price of 25.05 percent of the shares in Hotel Olumpia, one of the country's largest hotels located in the centre of Tallinn, were sold for 163.7 million voucher kroons.
A 24 percent stake in Esmeta fetched 817.7 million voucher kroons.
Investors made 1,834 offers for Estonian Gas shares, 1,266 for Hotel Olumpia and 74 offers for Esmeta.
Sarnet added the results from the offerings were better than expected.
